Vishuddhi Sena deployed to clean pilgrimage sites

A 1,000-member group called the Vishuddhi Sena has been deployed to maintain cleanliness at Sabarimala and other pilgrimage centers during the Mandalam season. The Sena's efforts are focused on keeping these sites clean.
